description: S6 checkpoint G4 / VER-02: retained Stirge attachment lifecycle and the shared Remove Stirge action, on the accepted C3a product (unchanged). Launch 2 (save): an active attachment after one drain round through a finished native save, with one labelled synthetic orphan Remove Stirge fact on a disposable unit no Stirge targets; the running process is then observed. Launch 3 (reload): a fresh process loads that save. Disclosed: Stirge BAB 100, prey HP raised, appear buffs removed, brains off, units woken, navmesh placement, pauses for observation.
